features.name: User Registration and Authentication
features.description: Students can create accounts and securely log in to access the platform.
user_stories: As a student, I can register with my university email so that I can access the platform.
As a student, I can log in securely so that I can access my notes and groups.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid university email, When a student registers, Then an account is created and verification email is sent.
Given valid credentials, When a student logs in, Then they are redirected to the dashboard.

features.name: Study Notes Sharing
features.description: Students can upload, browse, and download study notes shared by peers.
user_stories: As a student, I can upload my study notes so that other students can benefit from them.
As a student, I can search and download notes by subject so that I can study effectively.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid file, When a student uploads notes, Then the notes are saved and visible to others.
Given a search query, When a student searches for notes, Then relevant notes are displayed with download options.

features.name: Study Group Formation
features.description: Students can create, join, and manage study groups for collaborative learning.
user_stories: As a student, I can create a study group so that I can collaborate with peers on specific subjects.
As a student, I can join existing study groups so that I can participate in group discussions.
acceptance_criteria: Given group details, When a student creates a group, Then the group is created and the student becomes the admin.
Given an available group, When a student requests to join, Then they are added to the group member list.

features.name: Rating and Review System
features.description: Students can rate and review shared notes to ensure quality content.
user_stories: As a student, I can rate study notes so that I can help others identify high-quality content.
As a student, I can read reviews of notes so that I can decide which notes to download.
acceptance_criteria: Given downloaded notes, When a student submits a rating, Then the rating is saved and average rating is updated.
Given a note with reviews, When a student views the note, Then all reviews and ratings are displayed.

features.name: Notification System
features.description: Students receive notifications about group activities and new notes in their subjects.
user_stories: As a student, I can receive notifications about new notes in my subjects so that I stay updated.
As a student, I can get alerts about group activities so that I don't miss important discussions.
acceptance_criteria: Given new notes in subscribed subjects, When notes are uploaded, Then a notification is sent to relevant students.
Given group activity, When a message is posted, Then group members receive a notification.
